en.hubeali: And from him, from Ismail Bin Hammam who said,
‘Abu Al-Hassanasws said: ‘The Prophetsaww entered the Kabah, so hesaww Prayed Salaat in its four corners, Praying two Cycles in each corner’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from him (narrator of previous Hadith) from ‘Isma‘il ibn Hammam who has said the following:

“Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, entered al-Ka‘bah and performed Salat (prayer) in all of its four corners two Rak‘at in each.’”
